# ElectricPe

> India's largest trusted EV retail network. We sell affordable low-speed electric scooters (Xypro, Jett, 4ALL) — all licence-free and registration-free under Indian motor-vehicle law — through 30+ branded Mobility Centers across India. Owned and operated by Wattapp Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Bengaluru.

Every scooter in the catalogue is speed-limited to 25 km/h, which qualifies it as a low-speed EV under Indian regulation. No driving licence, no RTO registration, no road tax. Same-day delivery from any store.

## Brands & Scooters

- [Xypro lineup](https://electricpe.com/ev/xypro): Lithium-ion (80 km+, 4-hour charge), lead-acid (80 km+, 8-hour charge), and battery-swap variant. From ₹36,000 on-road.
- [Jett lineup](https://electricpe.com/ev/jett): 12-inch wheels, family scooter form factor, dual seat, 10 kg under-seat storage. Lithium-ion and lead-acid. From ₹54,000.
- [4ALL lineup](https://electricpe.com/ev/4all): Longest real-world range in the no-licence category (95 km). Lithium-ion and lead-acid. From ₹56,000.
- [All scooters](https://electricpe.com/ev)
- [Compare scooters](https://electricpe.com/ev/compare)

## Service

- [Service Promise (24-hour SLA + warranty)](https://electricpe.com/service): Motor 1 year, Controller 1 year, Lithium-ion battery 3 years / 40,000 km, Lead-acid 12 months, Charger 1 year.
